simple.meaning: בֹּהֶן (bôhen) appears 16 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering. The surrounding account also brings the name into death and blood crying from the ground.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Judges, beginning at Exodus 29:20. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, offering, altar, blood, death, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֹּהֶן (H931) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows בֹּהֶן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: בֹּהֶן (bôhen) / H931 is tracked through Exodus 29:20, Leviticus 8:23, Leviticus 8:24, Leviticus 14:14. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
